note: CAD assembly animation and simulated operation. Purchased parts are nominal envelopes. Follow the assembly manual for wiring, torque, calibration and physical test gates.

chapters.title: Ten STL designs. Two mounting options.
chapters.instruction: Fourteen prints with motor clamps; ten with motor ties. One-piece board platform and combined shoulder/neck.

chapters.title: 01 | Round reinforced base
chapters.instruction: Mate four Adafruit 3777 motors with 3766 wheels; lower the pairs into the one-piece base.
chapters.narration: Seat the four T T motors and wheels in the round, reinforced base.

chapters.title: 02 | Four motor screws, or ties
chapters.instruction: Use four identical printed hook clamps and one M3 screw per motor. Alternative: omit the clamps and use two longitudinal ties per motor.
chapters.narration: Four clamps and screws, or eight cable ties.

chapters.title: 03 | Choose one battery
chapters.instruction: Retain the Bioenno6Ah LiFePO4 pack, or use the specified12V7Ah or14Ah SLA case. Secure one pack with two padded zip-tie loops.
chapters.narration: Choose the original battery, or either lead acid option.

chapters.title: 04 | One printed board platform
chapters.instruction: Fit boards on the bench. Lower the single platform with its four legs over the battery. Secure the feet with screws or ties; keep terminal boots and wiring clear.
chapters.narration: Mount the boards on the printed platform. Lower its four legs over the secured battery.

chapters.title: 05 | Lower the skirt around the base
chapters.instruction: The whole213mm skirt lowers around the completed base assembly. Four M4 screws engage retained nuts. Lift the skirt for battery service.
chapters.narration: Lower the one piece skirt over the finished base.

chapters.title: 06 | Bearings in the combined shell
chapters.instruction: Shoulder and neck are one186mm print. Fit the lower608 bearing and retainers through the open bottom, then the spacer, upper bearing, shims and spindle.
chapters.narration: Fit both bearings and the spindle through the open upper shell.

chapters.title: 07 | Smaller concealed arm boxes
chapters.instruction: Feed the arms and servo carriers through the open bottom before fitting the speaker. Retain servo cases with M2 screws or ties. Horn screws remain required.
chapters.narration: Fit hidden arm servos, using screws or ties.

chapters.title: 08 | Integrated adjustable head drive
chapters.instruction: Fit the motor and wheel on the sliding carriage. Lower them from above. Fit the underside nuts while the shell is open, then retract the tyre.
chapters.narration: Lower the head drive. Fit its fasteners while the shell is open.

chapters.title: 09 | Fit controls and seat the shell
chapters.instruction: Fit the speaker, rear T-Display and switches after internal assembly. Connect labelled plugs, then lower and fasten the complete shoulder and neck.
chapters.narration: Fit the speaker and rear controls. Connect the harness and lower the complete upper shell.

chapters.title: 10 | Seat and retain the head
chapters.instruction: Keep the tyre retracted. Lower the head over the spindle, fit its washer and retaining nut, and verify free rotation.
chapters.narration: Keep the wheel clear. Seat the head and fit its retaining nut.

chapters.title: 11 | Adjust and lock contact
chapters.instruction: Seat and retain the head. Turn the adjustment screw to establish light tyre contact, then lock the carriage. Check a full revolution by hand.
chapters.narration: Seat the head. Adjust light wheel contact, lock the carriage, and check a full turn.

chapters.title: 12 | Local Wi-Fi control
chapters.instruction: Illustrative rear screen: direct access point, then access point plus a 2.4 GHz network.

chapters.title: 13 | Head and arm motion
chapters.instruction: Simulated continuous head rotation and circular arm-tip paths. Original robot sound effects.

chapters.title: 14 | Four-wheel motion
chapters.instruction: Simulated forward travel, broad moving arc, reverse and stop on a level floor.

chapters.title: Assembly complete | Prototype design
chapters.instruction: Four motor screws or ties | Raised one-piece platform | Smaller arm boxes | Integrated fixed head mount | Physical tests required.
